Filmography

Here are some recent credits that still exist on the internet. Rease has worked as a Technical Producer at Apple, spearheading launch campaigns for WWDC, Shot on iPhone, and Apple Vision Pro with talent like Dua Lipa, Usher, and The Weeknd. He has also spent over a decade behind the camera as producer, cinematographer, and technician on work for distributors like Netflix, ESPN, Nike, Rolex, A24 and the NFL. Most recently, he has been working on social campaigns for OpenAI, Anthropic, and SpaceX.
